messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: p99 tail latency spike detected on continuous-batching streaming path (us-west2). p99 = 1.9s, SLO = 500ms. Auto-incident created: INC-1763337777. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/contbatch-tail
ashley_oncall: acked. I'm on it. gathering quick context. :pager:
sanjay_sre: saw correlating alerts for KV cache churn and packer queue growth. suspect mixed sequence-length amplification + scheduler fairness tilt.
maria_runtime: confirming: stream-worker metrics show average batch_size up to 48 for some tenants, and 10k pending tokens in packer. streaming workers showing long tail on tokenization passthrough.
ashley_oncall: which customers are impacted? any customer pages or support tickets?
ellen_support: Support queue: two enterprise customers reported degraded streaming responsiveness in last 8m (acct: AcmeAI, AcctID: cust-823). No formal outage reported yet, but 3 support threads escalated.
dave_eng: throwing a quick diagnostic snippet: ```
# top packer queues (us-west2)
packer.queue_len{service="contstream"} 134, 127, 95
serving.kv_evictions{pool="us-west2"} 120/s
batcher.batch_size.p50 22 p95 44 p99 48
``` 
sanjay_sre: actionable mitigation options: 1) temporary cap max_batch_size=32 for cont-streaming; 2) enable stream-priority preemption so small streaming requests skip packing; 3) route high-mixedseq tenants to fallback-compat model (lower throughput but stable tail).
maria_runtime: we can flip 1+2 quickly via redwoodctl. Routing change needs a canary and may affect quality for some tenants.
ashley_oncall: do steps 1+2 now. prepare routing canary after we validate improvement. ashley -> sanjay: handoff if I need to step out in next 10m.
sanjay_sre: running command now: `redwoodctl set config contbatch.max_batch_size=32 --region=us-west2 --reason="p99-tail-mitigation"`
sanjay_sre: and enable preemptive flag: `redwoodctl set config contstream.streaming_priority_preempt=true --region=us-west2`
incident-bot: action log: config change submitted by sanjay_sre at 1763337795. Change id: cfg-1763337795. Deployment queued to control-plane.
ashley_oncall: any immediate signal improvements in metrics?
maria_runtime: 60s after change: p95 dropped from 800ms -> 420ms, p99 from 1.9s -> 760ms. packer.queue_len down 40%.
dave_eng: looks promising. still a residual tail at p99 ~760ms, but under SLO target? still above 500ms.
sanjay_sre: next step: quick canary reroute for the 2 most noisy tenants to fallback-compat model: `redwoodctl route tenant cust-823 -> model:compat-1 --weight=1.0 --region=us-west2 --note="tail mitigation canary"`
sanjay_sre: doing it for cust-823 now.
ellen_support: pinging customer AcmeAI to let them know we're mitigating; opening a temporary support bridge.
ashley_oncall: assigning handoff: I need to step out for brief meeting. sanjay_sre, please continue runbook, escalate to on-call lead if p99 > 700ms after 5m. I will rejoin ASAP.
sanjay_sre: ack. I'll continue and post updates here. I'll also monitor KV eviction rates; if they stay high, consider increasing KV cache size for contstream pool.
incident-bot: note: page escalation rule: if p99 > 700ms for 5m -> page eng-lead. Current window: 2m at ~760ms.
maria_runtime: additional tweak queued: reduce packer.timeout_ms from 200ms -> 120ms to prevent large assemblies; applying as config change now: `redwoodctl set config packer.timeout_ms=120 --region=us-west2`
ashley_oncall: timeline/status so far? include customer impact summary.
sanjay_sre: timeline: 0m alert; 2m - cap batch_size=32 & enable preemptive; 3m - p95 improved; 4m - canary route for cust-823; current: p95=420ms, p99=600-780ms (flapping). Impact: two customers reported degraded streaming, limited to specific endpoints with mixed sequence lengths. No errors, requests slow only. Customer-facing mitigation: routing cust-823 to compat-1; support notified.
dave_eng: note: logs show heavy padding amplification from a few tenants sending many short prompts that get padded into large batches. We should follow up with batching fairness long-term fix (fairshare by tenant + adaptive packing by seqlen).
ellen_support: AcmeAI acknowledged mitigation and said they see improvement on some sessions. Keeping them in the loop.
sanjay_sre: if p99 doesn't fall below 700ms in next 3m, escalate to eng-lead and consider temporarily throttling contributor tenants or moving more tenants to dedicated pools.
maria_runtime: monitoring: KV evictions dropped by 50% after packer timeout change. packer queue stabilized.
ashley_oncall: thanks team. Sanjay, take lead here. I'll rejoin in ~15m. Leave this thread pinned to oncall channel and update incident doc INC-1763337777 with final remediation and RCA steps.
sanjay_sre: will do. marking action items: (1) follow up RCA on mixed-seqlen amplification (owner: dave_eng), (2) design fairshare packing (owner: maria_runtime), (3) customer postmortem note (owner: ellen_support).
incident-bot: incident INC-1763337777 status: mitigation in progress. Handed to sanjay_sre. Last update at 1763337830.
ashley_oncall: :white_check_mark: closing handoff.
